# Diamonds might be forever, but are bits eternal?

If there is one thing we can be certain of it is the second law of thermodynamics - entropy (a measure of disorder) never decreases. The pyramids will fall, heat will even out, technology will fail and rust, and you will have ever more scattered documents in your home. It is a physical innevitability, but we can try to put it off for as long as possible.
